Definition: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hear, be attentive, heed, incline (of ears), attend (of ears), hearken, pay attention, listen; 1a) (Qal) incline, attend (of ears), hearken, pay attention, listen; 1b) (Hiphil) to pay attention, give attention
